# Repository audit

Audit the requested scope, or the complete repository when no scope is supplied.

1. Run `yarn agents:check`.
2. Invoke `$reuse-existing-patterns` for ownership and duplication checks.
3. Check architecture boundaries, UI relevance, source comments, tests, documentation, and product naming.
4. Compare renderer work with the read-only references when applicable.
5. Report findings first, then verified clean areas and remaining external uncertainty.
